📢 WE ARE HIRING | LEADERSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited – Manufacturing Unit

We are looking for experienced and result-oriented professionals to join our manufacturing team in the following leadership roles.

1. Jacket Production Head
📍 Location: Bangalore
💼 Experience: 10–15 Years

What We Are Looking For:

- Extensive experience in jacket manufacturing and production management.
- Strong expertise in production planning, line setting, and capacity utilisation.
- In-depth knowledge of garment construction, tailoring operations, and quality standards.
- Proven ability to drive production efficiency, productivity, and on-time delivery.
- Expertise in manpower planning, cost control, and continuous process improvement.
- Strong leadership skills to manage teams and achieve production targets.

2. Industrial Engineering (IE) Head- jacket 
📍 Location: Bangalore
💼 Experience: 10–15 Years

What We Are Looking For:

- Strong experience in Industrial Engineering within the apparel manufacturing industry.
- Expertise in SMV analysis, method study, time study, and line balancing.
- Proven track record in improving line efficiency, productivity, and operational performance.
- Strong knowledge of capacity planning, manpower optimisation, and production systems.
- Ability to analyse production data, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvement initiatives.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.

Who Should Apply?

Professionals with strong technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and a passion for manufacturing excellence.
